title: Ken W NDE 4322
content: I was looking down from about fifteen feet and was concerned for my buddies who were upset. I wanted to tell them how cool it was, but they couldn't hear me. I wanted them to be happy for me, but they were having no part of it. When I looked around, I realized there were many beings around me. They appeared to be a luminous fog with a gold core close to the top, a thin lucent pale greenish gold around the edges and had a wispy tail-like bottom. I think they were about three to four feet tall and about one foot in diameter. They moved as if they had mass and momentum and were not affected by the wind, which was strong at the time. It's hard to explain how glowing fog can be a being, an entity, but there they were. Without any similarities to the human form, they had easily recognizable human characteristics like age and gender specific body language, intent and purpose. It was clear that they had places to go and things to do. The first of them to notice me was a young girl who pointed me out to her three friends who all paused to chuckle at the new guy - me! It was clear that they were, in human terms, nice young girls of about ten or twelve years of age. They were buddies who seemed to have an agenda as they wanted to stay and watch, but had to move on. It seemed clear that I had just been killed and they thought it was funny. However, I didn't feel they were being rude or lacked compassion at all. I was confused, but felt that given a little time I would get the joke and be right there to welcome the newbie's with a chuckle of my own. Oddly, their humor made me feel at home, like part of the group, welcomed. As more of them saw me, I realized that watching newbies enter their realm was routine and that most of them found it humorous. As a group, they all seemed to enjoy their existence very much. I felt they had a sense of community and order. I thought how funny it was that I had no concern for the fact that I had just died. I was happy to be there. I couldn't see myself and had no body part, like a hand, that I could hold up in front of my eyes (no eyes either) to confirm what I was, but I assumed that I was one of them. I was floating above the ground like them. I could move about effortlessly like them. All I had to do was think to move. As I buzzed about, they seemed to tell me to settle down because I was new and didn't know how to move about yet. They weren't using words, but I could clearly understand them just as if you would easily understand 'watch out' in a language you didn't speak. Thought, knowledge and memory were not linear, one thing after the other, but all at once. The amount of sensory intensity would have overwhelmed me minutes ago in my human body, but this was way cool. I could see, hear, and conceive in ways that were inspiring and wonderful. I thought this being dead stuff is a lot different than I expected and I like it - a lot. It appears that at least part of the time they exist among us. They can see us, but respect our privacy. Soon, I was approached by some who seemed to know me and everything about me. It felt like they were family. Then what appeared to be a more ranking entity approached, as the others seemed to straighten up a bit (as if the boss showed up). Many of the entities seemed to be watching my situation to see how things would unfold (like rubberneckers). I suspect they knew what was next. Some dark entities (like the ones in the movie 'Ghost' that dragged the bad guy presumably to hell) came up and checked me out as the onlookers all seemed to hold their breath (even though they don't breathe). I sensed the dark things posed a threat, but they left me alone. The senior and the ones who knew me discussed my situation and told me I had to go back and that I would not remember. I was really disappointed, but did not question my orders. Next thing I was gasping in pain on the ground, ice and blood in my mouth and a bunch of feet all around me. I was back in my body, alive, and I knew I had a fight on my hands keeping it that way. In spite of my disappointment for having to leave the place where dead people have a great existence, I really wanted to live. I'm not sure about the whole reincarnation thing, but it certainly opened my mind. Not only did I feel they had been human in the past, but I felt they expected to be human again. It was as if they were a part of a natural lifecycle where being born and dying are just transitions between different forms of our existence. I believe with all my heart that we carry certain things like love and giving between these realms. Most all of what we feel is important as a human is of no importance in the other realm. They are excited to be human again as they can do things like having a family. They also really like the excitement of being in human form as it comes with struggles, challenges, danger, risk, unpredictability, etc. They miss things like making love, music, art, etc. Many of our core values are the same. They have a high regard for humans who are humble, giving and tough. For these reasons, the souls of firefighters, single moms and the like rank high. They like those who protect others and fight to survive. They are non-judgmental and quick to forgive, as they know the temptations humans face and know they will face them again themselves. I really love life in a way I am sure I would not have were it not for this experience. If everyone could have a glimpse of this realm, the world would be a much better place for humans - no killing, violence, etc. Don't try this getting killed thing at home and don't tell everybody how cool it is or they'll hurry to get there. Since the initial experience, I have had many paranormal situations involving many other people, which I'll try to add and share here soon. My hope is that I will find some way to help others with this ability. I hope that this will be of value to you in some way. Make it a great day, Sincerely, Ken.

arrival.other_being_detail: Many beings described as a luminous fog with a gold core and pale greenish-gold edges, with wispy tail-like bottoms; some appeared like 'nice young girls' (about 10–12) via body language; later a 'more ranking entity' and 'some dark entities (like the ones in the movie Ghost)'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Not explicitly stated; narrative implies an outdoor injury with ice and blood in mouth and 'buddies' present.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Dark entities approached and checked him out; a 'senior' entity discussed his situation with others and told him he had to go back and would not remember.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE and immediate presence among many beings; no tunnel/light described; return followed being told to go back.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Beings described as glowing fog with gold core and pale greenish-gold edges; humor/chuckling at 'newbies'; dark entities resembling those from the movie 'Ghost'; told he would not remember; later reports 'many paranormal situations involving many other people'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was looking down from about fifteen feet…”; “Thought, knowledge and memory were not linear… but all at once.”; “The senior… told me I had to go back and that I would not remember.”; “Next thing I was gasping in pain on the ground, ice and blood in my mouth…”
